description:
Closes #1830, closes #1819, closes #1816, close #1832

## Summary
- Precompile static regex patterns at module scope to avoid per-call compilation in hot paths.
- Keep settings-based regex patterns runtime to preserve test monkeypatch behavior.
- Optimize stdio transport to write JSON bytes directly (avoid decode/encode roundtrip).
- Fix SQL injection regexes to match block comments and keyword boundaries (intentional behavior change).

## Scope
- Hot-path validators, middleware, transports, and observability parsing.
- Optional follow-ups (tool_service/validation_middleware/translate_header_utils) intentionally excluded.

## Files Touched
- `mcpgateway/common/validators.py`
- `mcpgateway/middleware/db_query_logging.py`
- `mcpgateway/middleware/token_scoping.py`
- `mcpgateway/schemas.py`
- `mcpgateway/services/observability_service.py`
- `mcpgateway/transports/stdio_transport.py`
- `mcpgateway/transports/streamablehttp_transport.py`
- `mcpgateway/validation/tags.py`

## Behavior Notes
- Settings-based patterns (e.g., `SecurityValidator.*_PATTERN`, `settings.validation_tool_method_pattern`) remain runtime to allow tests to override them.
- SQL injection pattern matching is stricter and now matches block comments and keyword boundaries.
